market_question: Will Marco Rubio win the 2028 US Presidential Election?
reasoning: Marco Rubio faces a wide-open 2028 Republican field with multiple strong candidates, making his nomination probability only about 6–8%. Even if nominated, his general-election win chance would be around 50–60%, yielding an overall win probability well below the market's implied 13.9%. The current price appears inflated relative to the realistic odds.
evidence_points: Polymarket 2028 Republican nomination shows Rubio trading at roughly 6–8¢.
General-election implied probability suggests <5% true YES chance when combining nomination odds.
Historically, early long-shot candidates rarely sustain double-digit probabilities years ahead of an election.
sources_consulted: Polymarket – 2028 US Presidential Election (Rubio) and Republican Nominee markets
RealClearPolitics average for 2024/2028 GOP nomination polls
Political analysis of 2028 candidate field (e.g., Cook Political Report, Sabato's Crystal Ball)
